name: Billy Strings
notes: The current commercial peak of the flatpicking train beat: progressive bluegrass with jam-band structures, played at the top of the archetype's tempo band. The section states the rule this whole wing turns on: "the train beat is an ensemble function, not a drum part" — the banjo roll carries the continuous subdivision, the mandolin chop supplies the backbeat, and the upright bass supplies the two-beat kick. This is the entry where the guitar, not the banjo, carries the stream — "model very high note density in the guitar part — continuous 16ths at 150+ notated BPM — and no drum layer" — so `melody.densityPerBar` is [8,14], the busiest lead in this section, while the drum block stays at the wing's low velocities with `kick` a flat 2 on anchors 1 and 3, the hat on quarters and not continuous at a 0.025 fill density, and `percs` reduced to rim and shaker at −12 dB. `snare.offGridMs` −6 is the driven chop. The harmonic parameter is the documented rock and metal influence "showing up as modal vamps — extended i–♭VII and i–IV two-chord platforms for improvisation, which is a jam-band structure rather than a bluegrass one", with the instruction to "model a long-form single-chord or two-chord improvisation section as an available arrangement block". Both two-chord families are authored, `harmonicRhythm` carries an equal `vamp` share, `chordDurationBeats` runs [4,16], and the arrangement gives the bridge a 16–32 bar span. The bass takes "extended walking passages under the improvisation sections", i.e. independent_riff at `followRootsProb` 0.76. ⚠ The entry rates itself "medium-high on lineup, era, awards and instrumental role; medium-low on tempo and harmony numbers [LOW-CONF]" — so `bpm.mode` 165 inside the stated 100–210 band is INFERRED and carries that flag, as do the progression weights. ⚠ Also INFERRED: velocity tiers, `percs` contents and every countermelody number. ⚠ The improvisation section is stated as 16–64 bars; `sectionBars.bridge` caps it at 16–32, because the upper half of that range produces a pattern longer than this engine's useful clip and the cap is this author's decision, not the research's.
